structured_output.summary: The constructor, ChainDateTimeFormat, and the CreateDateTimeFormat option-resolution order (ResolveOptions, timeZone, component GetOptions, formatMatcher, dateStyle/timeStyle, defaults) follow the spec and keep observable Get order. Three paths are defects. (1) Steps 30.e and 31.g-h (DateTimeStyleFormat and Basic/BestFit matchers) are replaced by an empty record or by echoing the requested options. resolvedOptions then reports what the caller asked for, not the components of a chosen pattern, which the ticket explicitly requires. (2) Steps 14.a and 15.a hardcode "h12"/"h23" instead of reading hourCycle12/hourCycle24 from locale data, so e.g. ja with hour12:true gives h12 where the locale gives h11. (3) locale_hour_cycle turns ICU4X construction failures into a default h23 via .ok()?. No special-casing of test inputs, and no unrelated changes.

problems.question: made_up_results
problems.issue: Steps 31.g-h (BasicFormatMatcher / BestFitFormatMatcher) are replaced by returning the requested formatOptions unchanged (around line 522-524, 'format_options' as the bestFormat). The spec's bestFormat is a matcher result from the formats table, and the ticket says resolvedOptions must report the components of the pattern ICU4X picks. Here the caller's input is echoed back, and resolved_options then reports it.

problems.question: made_up_results
problems.issue: Step 30.e (DateTimeStyleFormat(dateStyle, timeStyle, styles)) is replaced by FormatRecord::default(), an empty record (around line 473). Styled formats therefore get no components and no computed pattern, where the spec computes bestFormat from the styles table.

problems.question: swallows_errors
problems.issue: locale_hour_cycle uses .ok()? on the parse, NoCalendarFormatter::try_new, and Time::try_new calls (around lines 171-174), and the match maps any failure to a default h23 (lines 177-179). An ICU4X failure is silently turned into a plausible hour cycle instead of being propagated or thrown as not-implemented. The calendar/numbering fallbacks at ~348/351 (unwrap_or("gregory") / unwrap_or("latn")) are the same kind of default.

problems.question: contradicts_spec
problems.issue: Step 14.a sets hc to resolvedLocaleData.[[hourCycle12]], but the code hardcodes Some("h12") (around line 358). Step 15.a sets hc to [[hourCycle24]], hardcoded as "h23" (around line 362). The locale-dependent values (e.g. h11 for ja) are not used.

problems.question: contradicts_spec
problems.issue: Because of the identity matcher (step 31.h, around line 522-524), the [[hour]] test in step 33 and the reported components in resolvedOptions both reflect the request, not the matcher's bestFormat. This differs from the spec whenever the matcher would pick a different format.

Do not echo the requested components as bestFormat. resolvedOptions must report the components of the pattern chosen, as the ticket says. (b) For dateStyle/timeStyle (step 30.d-e), either compute DateTimeStyleFormat or throw not_implemented. Do not return an empty record. (c) Step 14.a/15.a: read hourCycle12 and hourCycle24 from locale data (h11 vs h12 for 12-hour, h23 vs h24 for 24-hour) instead of hardcoding h12/h23. (d) Remove the .ok()? fallback in locale_hour_cycle. Propagate the failure or throw not_implemented. (e) The CALENDARS list is hardcoded and not from ICU4X. Derive it from ICU4X or throw not_implemented. (f) Verify that get_available_named_time_zone_identifier only accepts AvailableNamedTimeZoneIdentifiers, case-insensitively. IanaParserExtended may accept POSIX or GMT-style strings, which the spec rejects with RangeError. Also verify that ICU4X's canonical equals PrimaryIdentifier for links (e.g. Asia/Calcutta, Etc/UTC). (g) Remove the lossy-string conversion (agent.str_lossy) on the timeZone value if a lossless path exists. (h) Keep the component table order, the hour12 handling and the resolvedOptions key order as they are.
